config.abstain: no sentence shares a content word with the question (no reranker threshold or entity gate)

notes: Plain dense chunk RAG reference row: same index_notes.py chunker and intfloat/multilingual-e5-base bi-encoder as sqlite-graph-memory, ranked by cosine similarity alone (topk=60, no wikilink graph hop, no cross-encoder reranker) with the shared _extract.best_sentence floor and no cosine threshold (the 0.18 abstention rate comes solely from _extract.best_sentence returning (None, None, 0) when no sentence in the top-3 notes shares a non-stopword token with the question on 4/10 absent_entity questions). Beats sqlite-graph-memory on paraphrase (R@5 1.00 vs 0.50, where the mmarco cross-encoder demotes zero-overlap hits), while sqlite-graph-memory beats it on bridge (1.00 vs 0.87) and on abstention (0.45 vs 0.18).
